quarterly_data.signal: L3Harris 10-K: sales to U.S. Government customers, directly or through prime contractors (including foreign military sales funded through the U.S. Government), were 75% of fiscal 2025 revenue; no other customer accounted for more than 5%.

L3Harris 10-K: the Aerojet Rocketdyne segment provides propulsion and power systems to the U.S. Government (including NASA) and major aerospace and defense prime contractors; fiscal 2025 Space Propulsion & Power revenue rose $56 million on higher volume on a NASA program.
